title: Frequency mobile event facts and form fields stay readable within the current theme

source.ref: Mobile live browser audit 2026-10-15, The Wellness Club public event at 390x844

detail: Live public event /events/tg-the-wellness-club-2026-10-15 had 15px Email and Name fields (48px tall), and white date/location text below the decorative backdrop. On a 390px screen the backdrop ends around 468px while the stacked poster pushes the facts below 600px; screenshot showed white text against a nearly white fade. Candidate gives the mobile info/RSVP one opaque theme card with canonical text, removes nested RSVP card chrome, and repairs a font shorthand that used the colour token --fq-text-body as a size. Alias candidate makes canonical fields use the 16px body role below 760px, maps action/link/focus to the existing room-specific presence/on-accent pair, and derives Stage cards/glass from its already-cooled canvas/raised roles. Semantic live/reward/entity tones and artwork retained. Token guard unchanged at baseline; 39 theme/shell cases passed. Candidate full-app rendered after verification remains required; original 15px measurement is not proof of physical iOS zoom, and no production RSVP writes were attempted.

verify.evidence: Before: browser at 390x844 measured root=scrollWidth390, public event Email/Name font15px height48 and nav/RSVP/chat buttons44px; screenshot showed faded white facts. Pending after integration: render same public event plus a light/dark member form at 320/390/desktop; confirm mobile .input computes16px, title/date/address sit on opaque card with at least4.5:1 body contrast, desktop hero retained, no horizontal overflow, no unrelated semantic/entity colour change. Also review Stage menu/search and Mindless under the updated aliases. Localhost server ownership/alignment is controlled by Frequency Control; no competing server launched.
